items.source: Callback interface that can be implemented by beans wishing to customize the CouchbaseCacheManager.CouchbaseCacheManagerBuilder to fine-tune its auto-configuration before it is used to build the auto-configured CouchbaseCacheManager.
items.translation: 可被希望自定义 CouchbaseCacheManager.CouchbaseCacheManagerBuilder` 以在用于构建自动配置的 CouchbaseCacheManager` 之前微调其自动配置的 Bean 实现的回调接口。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个函数式接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
